input.title: Baby Christmas – I Ate the Bow. Worth It. Baby Bodysuit
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I ate the bow, worth it: a Christmas onesie for the baby who got more joy out of the ribbon than the present, and the baby's piece of our Christmas Credits family set.

The art is a 1950s Christmas-card scene: a cheerful, slightly lopsided decorated Christmas tree in a living room corner with big-bulb lights sagging off one branch, a few wrapped presents on a red rug (one with its bow missing and a torn corner), a wooden stepladder leaning beside it, and a small stool holding a candy cane and a tipped glass of milk with a half-eaten cookie. I ATE THE BOW. runs across the top and WORTH IT. across the bottom, in heavy deep-red and pine-green capitals on White and in cream and mustard capitals on Red, where the scene also gets a cream outline.

Dress the baby in it for Christmas morning and the family photo, next to the Mom, Dad and Kid pieces. It also works as a baby christmas outfit for a first Christmas. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit, envelope neckline, lap shoulders
  • 100% combed ring-spun cotton jersey
  • Fabric weight: 5 oz/yd²
  • Three-snap closure
  • Sizes 6M–24M
  • 2 colors: White, Red
  • Blank product sourced from India

Questions

How does it fit?
This baby jersey bodysuit is a Rabbit Skins 4424 in sizes 6M, 12M, 18M and 24M. Order your usual size for a regular fit or go up one for a roomier look. Compare the size chart with a piece you already own, and Graphic Tees Co. offers one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton jersey at 5 oz/yd², with lap shoulders, an envelope neckline and a three-snap closure. From Graphic Tees Co.: turn it inside out, wash it cold with similar colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach so the red, green and mustard inks stay bright, and do not iron over the print.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White and Red, the two colors the whole set shares. On White the headline is deep red and WORTH IT. pine green; on Red they turn to cream and mustard with a cream outline around the scene. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

Is there a matching set?
Yes. This is the baby's piece of the Christmas Credits family set; Mom, Dad and the kids each get their own line on the same tree art, each on its own page, and White and Red are the colors all four share so the photo matches.

Who is it a good gift for?
It suits the new parents, a grandparent shopping for a first Christmas, or an aunt who likes a matching family photo. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order, orders of $45 or more ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so it arrives before Christmas. Each piece is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days, and orders of $45 or more ship free.
